description: This Java source file 'PathAnimations.java' defines an Android Activity demonstrating path-based animation techniques using ObjectAnimator, Path, and custom properties. It includes setup for path traversal, animation initialization, and a nested CanvasView class to render the path and animate a view along it.

classes.name: PathAnimations
classes.description: Main activity class demonstrating path-based animations along with setup for different animation techniques.

classes.name: PathAnimations.CanvasView
classes.description: Custom View class that renders the path and manages drawing.

classes.name: PathAnimations.PointFToPointConverter
classes.description: TypeConverter to convert between PointF and Point for animation purposes.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the layout, and the layout change listener.

methods.name: setCoordinates
methods.description: Sets the view's position based on x and y coordinates.

methods.name: changeCoordinates
methods.description: Updates the position of the animated view.

methods.name: setPoint
methods.description: Sets the position using a PointF object.

methods.name: onCheckedChanged
methods.description: Handles radio button changes to start different animations.

methods.name: onLayoutChange
methods.description: Responds to layout changes to restart animation accordingly.

methods.name: startAnimator
methods.description: Configures and starts the ObjectAnimator based on user-selected animation type.
